stories.title: Democrats win US midterms in Michigan, Maine; Canada sees hopeful trade outlook
stories.summary: Democratic candidates won decisively in Michigan and Maine on Tuesday, with U.S. tariffs on Canada a prominent campaign issue in both states. Ontario Premier Doug Ford called the result a “victory for Canada,” while analysts said the outcome is unlikely to bring immediate tariff relief but may improve the environment for Ottawa to negotiate better terms as trade talks resume.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: Ather Energy among 15 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 30% in a month
stories.summary: Amid the market rally, 15 stocks from the BSE 500 Index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous year and can indicate increased market activity and investor interest.
stories.why: This can affect market expectations, company valuations, sector sentiment or capital flows.

stories.title: RBI sets up technical consultative committee to review market infrastructure
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has established a technical consultative committee comprising seven external members drawn from various financial institutions. The committee will engage with banks and other market participants to examine the functioning and efficiency of money and related derivative markets, and to assess domestic and international developments that affect market infrastructure.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.
